reason: Design-doc finding only, no code or behavior change. Re-ran design/evaluation/GOAL-2-backbone.md's Step 0 falsification against relevance_gate (previously only run against participation): the gate's raw model call now emits a real, mappable InferenceSpan (the tracing-replacement fix holds), but strands-agents-evals' TraceExtractor requires an AgentInvocationSpan at all three evaluation levels (TRACE/TOOL/SESSION) and the gate deliberately never produces one, so every built-in trace-reading evaluator still raises/returns empty for a gate case -- verified by calling nora.agent.telemetry.start_raw_model_span/end_raw_model_span (the exact production functions) directly against the real SDK mapper/extractor. A second, independent gap was found in the same pass: evals/backbone.py's AbsenceGrader reads NORA_SAID off environment_state, but evals.rebuilt.entry.gate() never populates outcome.said (by design -- the gate answers admitted, not said), so AbsenceGrader currently misgrades every gate case regardless of the SDK question. Recorded in design/evaluation/09-the-backbone-measured.md §1.1, 10-the-scenario-map.md §5, and 08-the-sdk-surface.md §4.2.
